_provenance.note: Not reachable from this sandbox (no live GitLab mirror — same CP-A3b deferral as every other gitlab-*.json). Hand-authored from the documented GitLab REST API v4 approvals response shape (https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/api/merge_request_approvals.html#get-configuration-1): `approved_by[].user.username` — the subset gitlab.mjs#prReviews reads. GitLab's approvals API carries no per-reviewer review-state history and no review body — each approver normalizes to exactly one `{state:'APPROVED', author}` entry (gitlab.mjs#prReviews), which is why this fixture, unlike the GitHub happy fixture, has no `body` field to drop: there is none to drop.
